blocks.text: The production of “Kailangan Kita: An Ogie Alcasid Musical” announced the upcoming auditions for performers who want to join its cast ahead of its 2027 theater debut. The auditions are open to performers aged 18 and above, regardless of gender or background. The first round will take place on Nov. 24 at the PETA Theater Center, while callbacks will follow on Nov. 28 at the Newport Performing Arts Theater. Interested applicants must register online.
